Measuring ${paintingData.dimensions}, this ${paintingData.year} artwork exemplifies the artist's mastery of light and color, evoking a profound emotional response.`\n    });\n  };\n\n  const successfully!\");\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = () => {\n    console.log(\"Deleting painting:\", paintingData.id);\n    // In a real application, you would send a delete request to an API\n    alert(`Painting '${paintingData.title}' deleted.`);\n    // Redirect to manage paintings page or similar\n  };\n\n  const activityItems = [\n    {\n      id: \"activity-1\",\n      title: \"Painting details updated\",\n      detail: \"Price, description, and SEO meta updated.\",\n      time: \"Just now\",\n      label: paintingData.editor,\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"activity-2\",\n      title: = {\n    header: (\n      <PageHeader\n        title={`Edit Painting: ${paintingData.title}`}\n        actions={[\n          { label: \"AI tools\", onClick: () => alert('Opening AI Tools for this painting.'), variant: \"secondary\" },\n          { label: \"View Public Page\", href: `/paintings/${paintingData.id}`, variant: \"ghost\" },\n        ]}\n      />\n    ),\n    table: (\n      <div className=\"p-6 bg-surface rounded-lg shadow-sm space-y-6\">\n        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSave(); }} className=\"space-y-6\">\n          <Input label=\"Title\" name=\"title\" value={paintingData.title} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Artist\" name=\"artist\" value={paintingData.artist} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Medium\" name=\"medium\" value={paintingData.medium} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Dimensions\" name=\"dimensions\" value={paintingData.dimensions} onChange={handleChange} placeholder=\"e.g., 30x40 inches\" required />\n          <Input label=\"Year\" name=\"year\" type=\"number\" value={paintingData.year} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Price\" name=\"price\" type=\"text\" step=\"0.01\" value={paintingData.price} onChange={handleChange} placeholder=\"e.g., 4500.00\" required />\n          <Select\n            label=\"Availability Status\"\n            name=\"availability\"\n            options={[\n              { value: \"Available\", label: \"Available\" },\n              { value: \"Sold\", label: \"Sold\" },\n              { value: \"On Hold\", label: \"On Hold\" },\n            ]}\n            value={paintingData.availability}\n            onValueChange={(value) => setPaintingData({ ...paintingData, availability: value })}\n            required\n          />\n          <div>\n            <Input label=\"Description\" name=\"description\" as=\"textarea\" rows={5} value={paintingData.description} onChange={handleChange} />\n            <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"ghost\" onClick={handleGenerateDescription} className=\"mt-2\">\n              Generate Draft {paintingData.imageUrl && (\n              <img src={paintingData.imageUrl} alt={paintingData.title} className=\"max-w-xs h-auto rounded-md border border-muted/20\" />\n            )}\n            <Input label=\"Upload New Image\" name=\"imageUrl\" type=\"file\" className=\"mt-4\" />\n            <div className=\"flex items-center mt-2\">\n              <input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"autoEnhance\" name=\"autoEnhance\" className=\"mr-2\" />\n              <label htmlFor=\"autoEnhance\" className=\"text-sm text-text\">Auto-enhance image on upload (AI)</label>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          <Input label=\"SEO Meta Description\" name=\"seoMetaDescription\" value={paintingData.seoMetaDescription} onChange={handleChange} placeholder=\"Concise description
